IB interview question

What is this company worth?

Enterprise value comes up in almost every first-round interview.

The question

Equity value $500M. Debt $200M. Cash $50M. What's EV?

A$550M
B$650M
C$700M
D$750M

Pick one, then swipe.

The answer
$650M
$500M
Equity value
+ $200M
Add debt
− $50M
Subtract cash

Why?

EV is the price to buy the whole business.

You buy the shares, take on the debt, and keep the cash.
